title: Хаб: compaction worker, one-shot `compact --pending` и исполнение drain-запросов
summary: `src/compaction.js` (новый Y.Doc: checkpoint, затем tail по seq → `Y.encodeStateAsUpdate` + JSON-проекция через src/schema.js/@hocuspocus/transformer с существующей проверкой потери TipTap-атрибутов → `POST checkpoint` с lease; 409 — отбросить без повтора), `src/worker.js` (цикл lease с интервалом `COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS`, приоритет drain_requested), `src/cli.js` (`serve` | `compact --pending [--deadline=<s>]`: без WS-сервера до пустого lease-ответа или дедлайна, exit 0 / 1 со списком document_id), `package.json` bin `vaulter-collaboration-hub`, Dockerfile CMD `serve`.
why: D26 ревизия 3 п.1: компактацию и drain исполняет только хаб; без worker документ с pending tail без открытой room не снимет marker, REST навсегда 409 (19). Hard risks: публикация по устаревшему lease; потеря атрибутов при проекции; offline-режим сообщает успех при оставшемся pending; worker конкурирует с живой room той же G (разрешается CAS backend).

include: src/{compaction,worker,cli}.js, src/index.js (запуск worker в serve), package.json bin, Dockerfile CMD
exclude: Отложено в PLAN4: `docker build packages/collaboration/hub`, offline `compact --pending` против реального backend на стенде

reads.why: границы P5, точные команды качества, размещение тестов, схема, ledger, прогрессия инвариантов
факты Hocuspocus 4.3.0, ledger, режимы, компактация, shutdown, management, лимиты
сценарии I17 этого пункта: линия и файл
Fast-набор D41: что исполняется в пункте

rules: Компактация читает checkpoint и tail одной G из `load`/lease-ответа; публикует covered_from = C, covered_through = H ровно прочитанного диапазона.
Результат merge = применению всех updates (C,H] к checkpoint; JSON-проекция с потерей атрибутов → checkpoint не публикуется, ошибка в лог и метрику.
`compact --pending` завершает работу только по пустому lease-ответу (exit 0) или дедлайну (exit 1 со списком оставшихся document_id).
guidance: compaction.test.js: 3 клиентских update на разных Y.Doc → checkpoint+tail мержится в состояние, равное `Y.mergeUpdates` всех; worker.test.js (19): мок backend отдаёт lease документа без открытой room → один POST checkpoint с covered (C,H); ответ 409 → повтора нет; compact-cli.test.js: запуск `node src/cli.js compact --pending --deadline=2` дочерним процессом против мока → exit 0 при пустом втором lease, exit 1 и document_id в stderr при непустом до дедлайна.

result.notes:
Hub compaction for D26 rev.3 p.1. (1) src/compaction.js: compactLease(entry) merges a lease entry on a new Y.Doc: the checkpoint C, then the tail (C,H] in seq order through persistence.js replayLog, the same replay a room load uses. It checks the tail is exactly C+1..H and returns state = Y.encodeStateAsUpdate (base64), content = the TipTap JSON projection, coveredFrom C, coveredThrough H and expectedCheckpointVersion. It refuses (CompactionError: invalid_lease, incomplete_tail, empty_log, invalid_update, unknown_type, projection_loss) anything that cannot become a faithful checkpoint. Projection loss reads the projection back through the hub schema and applies schema.js lostAttributes, the same check as buildSeed; an unknown node or mark also counts as a loss. (2) src/worker.js: createWorker() makes one lease call per pass (hub_id, max = VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_BATCH), then compacts and publishes each entry in the backend's order (drain requests first). A full batch is leased again at once; otherwise the next pass waits VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS (default 2000). A checkpoint is published only while the lease holds, with a 2 s margin, measured against the answer's Date header so clock skew does not stretch it. Any 409 (checkpoint conflict, epoch mismatch) is dropped and never retried. Network errors, 5xx and 429 are retried with retry.js, capped by the lease. A failed compaction is logged and counted (failures, projectionLosses) and nothing is published. drain({deadlineMs}) repeats passes until an empty lease answer, accepted only once every unspent lease of the run has expired; otherwise it stops at the deadline with the remaining documents. stats(), start(), stop() and events (outcome, compacted, protocolMismatch) are exposed. (3) src/backend.js: leaseCompaction() and publishCheckpoint() (signed, no room token, protocol 2) and the CHECKPOINT_CONFLICT code. (4) src/cli.js (#!/usr/bin/env node, mode +x, package bin vaulter-collaboration-hub): 'serve' boots index.js; 'compact --pending [--deadline=<s>]' (default 60 s) runs without a WebSocket server. Exit 0 = nothing leasable is left, exit 1 = deadline passed with the pending document ids (generation, last outcome) on stderr, exit 2 = usage or config error before any backend call. (5) src/index.js exports boot() and starts the worker after listen (server.vaulterWorker); a protocol mismatch from the worker is reported to the persistence. (6) src/config.js: VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_INTERVAL_MS (min 10) and VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_BATCH (1..100). The numeric checks moved to one table, and validateCompactConfig() is new: backend URL in production, webhook secret required, no origins or ports. (7) package.json: bin, start/dev through cli serve, check covers cli/compaction/worker. Dockerfile: ENTRYPOINT [node, src/cli.js], CMD [serve]. (8) Tests: compaction.test.js (3 client updates from separate Y.Docs plus a checkpoint equal to Y.mergeUpdates; seed-first log; republish when H = C; every refusal), worker.test.js (lease without an open room → one checkpoint covering (4,5], HMAC and protocol headers, no Authorization; 409 conflict or epoch not retried; 5xx retried with the same publication; exhausted series; expired lease not published; projection loss logged and counted; order and full batch; lease failure logged once; protocol mismatch event; drain() semantics; config keys), compact-cli.test.js (child process against a loopback mock: exit 0 after an empty second lease, exit 1 with document 77 on stderr after about 2 s, exit 1 naming a 401 lease failure, exit 2 for usage/config errors with no backend call, parseArguments, bin, shebang, Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT/CMD). (9) tests/baseline: scripts/t baseline --write -p hub (hub 19 → 22 files). Other commands, all exit 0: npm run check; node --test retry/ledger/webhook/v1-paths/config/security (79 pass); scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub; throwaway control-flow checks of worker.js and cli.js under stubbed yjs/transformer/tiptap/dotenv in $TMPDIR (10 pass, not committed).

What did run: npm run check (exit 0); the dependency-free hub tests retry/ledger/webhook/v1-paths/config/security (79 pass); a scratch run of the config assertions; and 10 throwaway control-flow checks of worker.js and cli.js with stub modules in $TMPDIR. Those cover publication and body, 409 without retry, 5xx retry and exhaustion, an expired lease, compaction refusals, ordering and full batch, lease failures and protocol mismatch, the drain() semantics, and real CLI child runs with exits 0, 1 and 2. The real Yjs and TipTap behaviour (merge equal to Y.mergeUpdates, projection and attribute-loss detection, the RangeError for an unknown node, Yjs throwing on the payload [1]) is unverified.

V4 (scripts/t baseline --compare, all suites) was not run as written: vue discovery (npx vitest list) needs the npm registry, which this sandbox refuses (as in P5.4–P5.7). scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub exits 0 after scripts/t baseline --write -p hub (hub: current 22, the three new files).
pending: An empty lease answer does not prove that no pending marker is left. The backend (P5.5) leases a generation only when it has a drain request or reached a trigger (500 updates / 1 MiB / 10 min), and skips generations under another hub's unexpired lease. compact --pending exit 0 therefore means 'nothing leasable is left'. Unspent leases of its own run are waited out, so a failed or conflicted document is never hidden. The sound offline recovery order is: vaulter:collaboration:drain (it requests a drain for every marker and keeps the requests when the hub is down), then compact --pending, then vaulter:collaboration:drain again to confirm from the markers. With the module raw-disabled (config=false) the hub endpoints answer 404, so compact --pending cannot help there.

The lockfiles were not updated for the new package.json 'bin': packages/collaboration/hub/package-lock.json and the root package-lock.json are masked in this sandbox. Both show as modified in git status only because of the mask (git cannot hash them); this piece did not touch them. npm ci does not validate a root package's bin, so CI installs are unaffected; a later npm install adds the bin to the lock entry.

Docs not updated (D43 docs pass): packages/collaboration/hub/README.md, docs/guides/hub.md and .env.example do not mention 'serve' / 'compact --pending', the image ENTRYPOINT, or the VAULTER_COLLAB_COMPACTION_* variables. No docs guard test covers them. `node src/index.js` still boots the hub with its worker, so the Makefile and scripts/collab-e2e.sh keep working. No compose file or workflow overrides the image command.
